skill.summary: Provides detailed analysis of American Express's premium closed-loop charge card model, market positioning, revenue streams, and affluent customer base.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release introducing detailed company profile of American Express  
- Covers history, business model, competitive moat, and key financial/market data  
- Explains closed-loop vs open-loop payment networks and charge card vs credit card models  
- Includes interesting facts and comparisons relevant to premium credit card research
